ns2:course.label: Audiological Assessment Lab
ns2:course.description: Clinical laboratory experience in audiological assessment including the evaluation, identification, diagnosis and treatment of hearing loss. Patient counseling and case history intake skills are addressed. Prerequisite: SHS 550 or concurrent enrollment in SHS 550.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: SHS 550 or concurrent enrollment in SHS 550.
